notes.title: Auver 1.3 is out!
notes.notes:
[h2]New in 1.3:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Full Gamepad Support:[/b] The game now supports Xbox Input!
[*][b]New Power Generator:[/b] The old one sucked... well, this one doesn't.
[*][b]Better Grass:[/b] Grass visuals have been enhanced.
[*][b]Animation Fixes:[/b] I’ve addressed various animation issues.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Numerous bugs have been squashed. They dont deserve to be alive >:D
[*][b]Optimization:[/b] I’ve made various performance improvements.
[/list]

[*]Fixed UI gamepad bugs

[/list]

notes.title: Auver Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Below are all the new things and bug fixes in Auver 1.2.

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*]This is probably the biggest change in this update. I've optimized every single level in the game as much as possible, so you will now experience up to 30 extra fps.
[/list]

[b]Graphics Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved lighting!
[*]More environmental details!
[*]Enhanced materials!
[*]I will stop using exclamation marks after this line!
[/list]

[b]Additional New Stuff[/b]
[list]
[*]DLSS Support for RTX cards.
[*]Enhanced controller support (the game is still not fully playable with just a controller).
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The game is no longer a buggy mess (more details below).
[*]The UI has been reworked behind the scenes, so buttons are less likely to unfocus now.
[*]No errors in game settings when no game has been saved yet.
[/list]

[u]This may be the final update for Auver, as I have other future projects upcoming.[/u]
